description: Everything needed to write an accurate project review or hand-off document: the shape of the work, every resolved thread and how it ended, what was deferred and why, what is still open, and the longest conversations quoted in full, which is where decisions were made. Every entry carries its item id, so each claim in your document can be traced back to its thread. Quote; do not invent outcomes the threads do not state.

offset.description: With section: where to start, from the previous result's 'more' line.

projectId.description: Project to review. Optional if a project is bound.

section.description: Omit for the overview (all counts, first rows of each section). Name one to read it in full, a page at a time.
